authority: Independent Chief Auditor findings, G0 scientific reliability closure: legitimate prospective support of post-screening hypotheses was penalized; pre-screening and post-screening discovery were mixed; malformed output handling.

changes.metrics.post_screening_support: Counts only INADMISSIBLE supports of a post-screening hypothesis: the screened observation, an observation older than the hypothesis, a repeat of the screened check (same capability, inputs, parameters; any backend), or the screened output content. These are the 012y/011m guard's bases, re-derived by the scorer from facts the collector reads (lab_brain.evaluation.collect). A prospective, independent support is reported as post_screening_support_admissible and is not a failure.
changes.metrics.false_confirmation: A post-screening hypothesis confirmed with at least one admissible support, and discriminating on a true cause, is not a false confirmation. Without an admissible support it still is.
changes.metrics.considered: considered_pre_observation_rate and considered_post_screening_only_rate are reported side by side so screening's discovery is never read as the reasoning's. The threshold considered_rate_on_cheap_visible_min keeps its value and its definition (any origin), because it measures what the screening configuration is for; the split is disclosed next to it.
changes.acceptance.malformed: A record the scorer cannot read is counted as malformed and fails acceptance (must be 0). The scorer never raises on it.
changes.records.supports: Each hypothesis lists its SUPPORTS relations with four provenance facts instead of a bare count. A record with a bare count is malformed.

unchanged: Every threshold value, configuration, split, case, truth file and file hash of protocol.json 1.0.0; amendment 1 (the former holdout is exposed-regression evidence).
leak_note: This harness computes `leak` from the prompts sent to the model only, so it never counted a correct conclusion as a leak. The defect of counting answers in outputs was in the independent-holdout scorer (lab_brain.evaluation.scoring 1.0.0), corrected in 2.0.0.
